sentences.show: The most famous scenes of the Russian Revolution were mostly staged, years later.
The real night came on this day in 1917.
It's called the October Revolution because of Russia's old calendar. Everywhere else, it was November.
Lenin's Bolsheviks moved on the Winter Palace in Petrograd.
The cruiser Aurora fired a single shot from the river. A blank.
Inside, about 3,000 defenders, including a battalion of women.
Most surrendered. It went almost without casualties.
Three years later, the storming was restaged, for 100,000 spectators.
Then Sergei Eisenstein filmed it, with fierce fighting that never happened.
That's the film you're watching. For decades, it was taken as the truth.
Also on this day: the first woman was elected to Congress, and Ulysses Grant fought his first battle.
